readme: Built-in, read-only drill import presets, keyed by header signature (src/utils/drillPresets.js).
Each preset: id, vendor, kind (collars | surveys | assays | lithology | alteration), label (read as 'Looks like <label>: use its mapping?'),
sources (URLs of the published documentation or sample export the headers come from), required (headers that must all be in the file),
columns ({ field: header }, the fields in src/utils/drillDb.js FIELDS), and optionally elements ([{ column, name, unit }]) and
missing (strings read as no value, replacing the default -99, -999, -9999).
Headers compare without case, spaces or punctuation. Add only headers taken from a cited source or a real export sample.
Skipped for want of a public header list (2026-10): acQuire (export pages are user-defined; the GIM Suite help is behind a sign-in),
Geotic (no published export format). MX Deposit exports use the labels each account configures, so only its fixed header fields are here.

presets.label: an MX Deposit collar (header) export
presets.notes: Export Data: CSV headers match the labels in MX Deposit; the header file holds the top coordinates row as columns prefixed 'coordinates.' (coordinates.grid, coordinates.northing, coordinates.easting) and the export-grid copy as 'converted.coordinates.'. Headers and Fields: 'Hole number' is a required header field. The native coordinates are mapped; coordinates.grid names their grid.
